podcast.title: Morrissey's First Band
podcast.body: This group was Morrissey's first serious attempt at a musical endeavor, featuring guitarist Billy Duffy. It was a short-lived project, with Billy Duffy later forming The Cult. "His first series attempt at doing something was in a group called the nosebleeds, which featured a guitarist by the name of Billy Duffy..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About The Smiths

xref.title: First Band - The Nosebleeds
xref.body: Morrissey's first serious attempt at music was with a group called The Nosebleeds, which also featured guitarist Billy Duffy. This group had a short lifespan before its members moved on to other projects. "His first series attempt at doing something was in a group called the nosebleeds, which featured a guitarist by the name of Billy Duffy..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About The Smiths

xref.title: Formed by Billy Duffy
xref.body: Guitarist Billy Duffy formed The Cult with Ian Astbury a couple of years after his brief tenure in The Nosebleeds with Morrissey. "Billy going on to form the cult with Ian Aspery a couple of years later."
